atAGlance: Gà hầm thuốc bắc is chicken simmered with Chinese medicinal herbs, usually with black chicken or tender pieces, dates, goji berries, and dark broth.
whatItIs: Gà hầm thuốc bắc is chicken simmered in a dark herbal broth with Chinese-Vietnamese medicinal herbs, dates, goji berries, and sometimes black chicken.
howToEnjoy: Sip the broth first; it can taste earthy, sweet, bitter, and medicinal. Eat the chicken slowly with rice or noodles if served.
howLocalsOrder: Order gà hầm thuốc bắc when you want a restorative herbal chicken soup. Ask whether it is black chicken and whether the portion is one person or shared.
worthKnowing: Thuốc bắc points to northern/Chinese-style medicinal herbs, a flavor family travelers may find earthy and unfamiliar.
goodToKnow: The dark herbal broth is the point; expect medicinal warmth and black chicken or bone-in pieces rather than a light chicken soup.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần gà hầm thuốc bắc.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of chicken stewed with Chinese herbs.
